Q9033.reason: VCLT Article 31 requires good-faith interpretation by ordinary meaning in context and in light of object and purpose; D is wrong because it says 'only' object and purpose.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is an overgrown firm mass of scar tissue beyond the wound; a fine hairline scar is normal healing, not a keloid.

Q9037.reason: Prolonged ventilation and weaning is a standard tracheostomy indication; a tracheostomy bypasses the airway and does not repair paralyzed vocal cords.
